preview: Soumitra Kand shares his internship interview experience at Kotak Life, detailing the resume shortlisting, online assessment, and a combined technical and HR interview round.
content: KOTAK LIFE Internship interview Experience Soumitra Kand Branch: Information Technology (TY) Resume Shortlisting Students were shortlisted on the basis of their Resumes for the Technical Assessment. Around 60 people (CS + IT) gave the online test. Online Assessment The online assessment consisted of 5 sections: 1. Aptitude (10 questions) 2. Logical Reasoning (10 questions) 3. Verbal Aptitude (10 questions) 4. Java (10 questions) : Questions related to the core concepts of Java were asked (OOPS concepts, Garbage Collector, etc.) 5. Psql (10 questions) : Some SQL queries and theory questions based on PostgreSQL. It was a bit tougher section and couldn’t attempt all of the questions as time was limited. The overall test was on a medium level of difficulty. As there were a lot of questions, time management was crucial. Results to test came out a few days later and around 15 people were shortlisted for the interview process. Interview Process PPT and interviews were conducted on 21st December. It only had 1 round (Technical + HR) and lasted for around 15-20 minutes. Questions were as follows: Introduction Firstly the interviewer asked me to introduce myself. Been preparing for this question for a long time, so I was confident in answering :) It is better to prepare for such questions beforehand. I gave my basic introduction, the tech stack that I used and the languages that I knew. (I use Java for coding and he was a bit interested in that). The interviewer was pretty friendly and gave me his introduction too. Projects I was asked to explain some of the projects mentioned in my resume. I had made some Flutter Projects and done 2 internships (Off-Campus) prior to this. He asked a lot of questions about my previous internship and the role that I had over there. It was a Backend developer role. So he asked about the technologies that I used like Docker, AWS, Django, etc. What is docker and where is it used? Docker is a software platform that allows you to build, test, and deploy applications quickly. It packages software into standardized units called containers that have everything the software needs to run including libraries, system tools, code, and runtime. It allow devs to package an application with all of its requirements and configurations What AWS services have you used and explain them? I have worked with AWS EC2, S3, Route 53, RDS. So I explained how and why I used these services. He asked a few questions about S3 like its advantages and disadvantages. Other than this, we talked about GCP and drew some comparisons between AWS and GCP. Which would you choose between a SQL and NoSQL database? As I had not worked a lot with NoSQL databases, I naturally answered with SQL databases. Also SQL databases have various features like: ● Managing and handling all relational databases (Primary and Foreign Keys) ● Ease of Use ● Language (SQL being a standard and familiar language.) ● Performance ● Scalability For further reading: SQL and NoSQL databases SQL Now the interviewer asked some questions on DBMS and SQL. Where are and why are indexes used in SQL? A SQL index is a quick lookup table for finding records users need to search frequently. An index is small, fast, and optimized for quick lookups. It is very useful for connecting relational tables and searching large tables. Explain the different Normal Forms in DBMS Normalization is the process of minimizing redundancy from a relation or set of relations. Redundancy in relation may cause insertion, deletion, and update anomalies. So, it helps to minimize the redundancy in relations. Normal forms are used to eliminate or reduce redundancy in database tables. Normal Forms in DBMS - GeeksforGeeks Concluding Lastly the interviewer asked if I had any questions for him. You must always ask 1 -2 questions at the end of the interview. So I asked what kind of tech stack do interns work upon at Kotak Life. He answered accordingly and my interview came to an end.
